page.overview:
Who is Money Back Fly?

The Money Back Fly is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"When Dim, the "ferocious beast," bawls about an owie from Rosie's whip during the wild animal act, a frustrated fly demands his money back. He's too late. P.T. Flea doesn't give refunds after the first two minutes of the show."

The Money Back Fly walks up to P.T. Flea and angrily demands that he give him his money back, but P.T. then says that there are no refunds after the first two minutes.
